name: sparks_of_tomorrow_promise
about: Sparks of Tomorrow story Short: a Meiji Era where the fathers of electricity all died and steam rules; Kihachi's brother lights a forbidden bulb - this is electric power, you and I will create the Age of Electricity - then goes to war and never comes back. The drop runs Kihachi picking up the promise himself.

story.why: thus evolved a different technology, making the Meiji Era the era of steam
this is the 20th century! This is electric power! You and I can create the Age of Electricity!
he took the Catalog off to war and never came back. You broke that promise, big brother.

title: In A World Where Electricity Was Never Invented, One Boy Keeps His Brother's Promise
hook: The fathers of electricity all died young, and the Meiji Era ran on steam. Kihachi's brother showed him a single light bulb - then went to war and never came back.

outro.why: I'll do everything I can to create the Age of Electricity!
